title: 6/06–6/07 EOD contest_state health check paged a false CRITICAL 'STALE' on the expected overnight settlement lag
tier_reason: a false CRITICAL DM (alert noise, at most one per EOD run, not a storm); the pick path's own freshness gate was unchanged, so no delivery, entry or state impact is evidenced

contract.text: The contest_state health check pages CRITICAL 'STALE' only for genuine staleness of the contest observation (the week-long-freeze class); the expected one-day overnight lag between local settlement of day D and the next contest fetch is not an alert.
contract.source: src/bts/health/contest_state.py EXPECTED_OVERNIGHT_LAG_DAYS (58c9adc); ARCHITECTURE.md health-check table, 'contest_state' row ('level-aware staleness … must not DM-spam')

mechanism.text: health.contest_state.check raised CRITICAL 'contest state is STALE' whenever contest state was expected and contest_state_is_fresh was false (source_date < latest resolved pick), with no allowance for the one-day lag; the scheduler's end-of-day run_all_checks runs after it settles day D (latest resolved -> D) but before the next-morning fetch-contest-streak cron (01:10/02:10 ET) advances source_date to D, so the expected lag was present at the EOD run

residual.text: The level-aware fix still measured the gap in calendar days, so the first played day after an n-day no-pick gap would page a false CRITICAL (All-Star break deterministic); fixed by aa6b7b1 (settled-pick steps) and later aligned by 56f9726.
residual.source: docs/audit/2026-06-09-fable5-full-audit.md [P1] 'contest_state gap is calendar-days, not settlement-steps'; aa6b7b1 (I-059); 56f9726 (I-063)

watchdog.trigger: at the end-of-day health run, a contest_state CRITICAL is emitted while the contest source_date trails the latest locally settled pick by exactly one settlement step and the next scheduled contest fetch (01:10 ET) has not yet run — an expected state paged as STALE
watchdog.recovery_assertion: after the 01:10/02:10 ET fetch the contest source_date equals the latest settled pick with no CRITICAL outstanding; only a lag of more than one settled pick that persists past the 13:30 ET fetch pages

evidence.what: EOD health runs after the scheduler settles day D but before the next-morning fetch advances the contest source_date to D, so the expected one-day overnight lag 'fired a CRITICAL "STALE" DM most nights' — alert fatigue that could mask a genuine stale event
the STALE CRITICAL (expected and not contest_state_is_fresh) was added 2026-06-06 16:03 ET exactly as the contest-streak spec required; before it the check alerted only on missing/invalid state
